regime_context: Detector shows a narrow, non-dominant leadership at the top of a 17-theme HK board: Energy (H-shares) leads with score 1.37 and the highest durability_bar (0.71, 'trend'), but only 4 of 17 themes are trend-gate eligible (frac 0.24) and one_narrative is false. The absolute-trend gate is validated for drawdown control on this market (gate_helps true), and the rotation margin over Banks is thin (0.157) with absorption 0.45, so leadership is not crowded but not strongly absorbing. Track record looks good in headline numbers (44/45 hits) but a ~0.98 hit rate on a momentum lens is implausible for a rank-IC~0 instrument, so I treat it as directionally favourable but downgrade implied confidence.
emerging_watch: Watching whether the Energy–Banks rotation margin (0.157) expands beyond roughly 0.35 with Banks losing eligibility while Energy stays eligible — that would confirm the existing leader holds rather than hand off; if instead Banks overtakes Energy on rank with both still eligible, that retires the single-leader read.
